changeClass: shared presentation only; no lesson content-version increment

scope.excluded: Decorative node icons and logos; download-only SVGs are not embedded teaching figures.

presentation.changed: ReviewedSvgVisual uses column width, automatic height, no fixed/minimum pixel canvas width or forced horizontal scroller.
presentation.alreadyResponsive: SourceBody sourceImage and legacy MATLAB figure img already use width:100%, max-width:100%, height:auto.
presentation.inlineRoot: Preserve viewBox and all child geometry; remove root width/height and set preserveAspectRatio=xMidYMid meet.
presentation.smallScreens: Labels shrink proportionally. Original SVG zoom links and directly visible reflowing explanations remain. This does not rearrange SVG nodes or guarantee small-screen label legibility.

verificationLimits.nativeQa: Local librsvg proportional rendering and pixel inspection, not browser CSS/layout or live-site readback.
verificationLimits.browserMobileKeyboard: Not performed; previously restricted browser routes not retried.
verificationLimits.production: Not established by local checks; requires approved merge and exact-commit Pages workflow.
